objective: Agent runs the mr-review phases as SKILL.md prescribes; this file starts with the D8 naming dimension. Local mode: one get_naming_lexicon call with `changes` (base = target branch, read at its merge-base with HEAD) reviews every name the diff's added hunks declare, findings grouped by verdict. External mode (MR branch not checked out): names[] built from the diff's added lines. MISFIT / NEW_TERM / COLLISION surface as findings with the suggestion, holder or existing declaration as evidence. Cases with status 'superseded' are kept as history and not scored.

cases.context: Prime `## Enrichment` lists codegraph.symbols (get_naming_lexicon is available). Local review; the diff adds `row = find_vendor_envelope(id)` in app/services/tax_automation/importer.rb, returning a TaxAutomationDocument.

mustDo: Run D8: get_naming_lexicon with names[] = the identifiers the diff declares (row, find_vendor_envelope) scoped to the touched dirs
Turn MISFIT / NEW_TERM into a minor finding whose fix is the returned suggestion, citing the holder file as precedent
Word the comment body in plain language (no MISFIT / lexicon / tool names)
mustNotDo: Judge the names by taste or by grep / semantic_search on the draft name
Report naming as 'not assessed' while codegraph is on

cases.failureMode: Agent skips the naming dimension or flags names without project evidence
cases.reason: get_naming_lexicon reviews a diff itself through `changes` (bd tea-rags-mcp-fdef2); hand-listing the diff's identifiers into names[] stays only for external mode, where the MR branch is not in the working tree
